rule_class: Based on reviewed CLI draft; detect hollow squares on the visible seven-by-seven lattice, remove its central separator, then compare packing toward the distinguished colour side against clockwise/counterclockwise packing relative to the marked edge. All demonstrations must fit; surviving query predictions must agree. No preferred mode or malformed-input fallback.
limitations: Fixed native30x30/lattice7x7 geometry; three explicit mechanism hypotheses, not universal ARC rule identification. Palette identifies distinguished roles. Native independent reflections/transposes retained.
evidence_decoder: Independent colour-component bounding boxes; target uses vectorized hollow-square stencil. Both compare complete packed output grids.

audit.audit_scope: 250 fresh queries held fixed while resampling3demo context using visible lattice packing evidence only; no query labels in admission; all four pairs executed under8D4per acceptedepisode.

assembly.scope: Local full-quota production-assembler audit only.1200unique native pool pairs,1000requested fresh bases. Grid pool then combined program/grid make_record on every augmented row; temporary audit rows removed,no public dataset or training launched.

tests: Odd-handed native cases, counterfactual clockwise context, all native and external transforms, hypothesis-set D4 closure, canonical fixtures, malformed/conflicting demonstrations. Query output unavailable to evidence selector.
